description: This file defines the 'Connection' interface within the Eclipse Ditto project, detailing properties and behaviors related to connectivity configurations, including identification, status, credentials, URI, lifecycle, and other connection parameters.

classes.name: Connection.JsonFields
classes.description: Defines JSON field definitions for the Connection interface, including schema version, ID, name, connection type, status, credentials, source/target configurations, URI, lifecycle, tags, and specific configuration options.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Checks if the Connection has the specified lifecycle status.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder initialized with the current Connection instance for modifications.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON representation of the Connection, including only non-hidden fields.
